intro.title: Block chords
intro.text: Now all three triad notes at once. I is C major, IV is F major, V is G major. The right hand moves as little as possible: only one or two fingers change.

intro.title: How the mic scores this
intro.text: Where both hands start notes together, Keyboard mode scores your right hand (the top note). Both hands get scored once chord detection lands. Taps mode scores every note.
